newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber prices down in trading lull.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber prices down in trading lull.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower after the market drifted without trading interest.
"The market is like a yo-yo. It's up one day and down the other," said a dealer. "It's very difficult for buyers and sellers to take positions."

At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted December RSS1 buyer at 320.50 cents ($1.27) a kg, down a half-cent from Wednesday's close. December SMR 20 was a cent lower at 310.
Traders offered the SMR CV at 366 cents, SMR L at 346, SMR 5 at 322, SMR 10 at 314, SMR 20 at 311 and drum latex at 237.
Traders said prices could stay firm in the near-term due to rains which were pressuring the supply of far materials.
The INRO five-day moving average rose to 244.30 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Nov 20 from 244.26 on Nov 19. The daily indicator price dipped to 244.68 from 244.62.
